subject: Your timing note for the week
body:
This week, try one calm planning ritual: before a focused task or meaningful conversation, check whether the hour feels clearer or heavier for reflection.

VedicHour rates all 18 planetary hours in plain English, so your grid can become a simple prompt for timing awareness, not certainty. If you are considering a paid report, NEWUSER30 gives 30% off your first one.

Your Life, Decoded Hour by Hour.
For reflection and planning only. Not medical, legal, financial, or emergency advice.
linter_reason: Emphasizes timing awareness, calm reflection, and avoids blocklist terms. Includes disclaimers.
